description: PCABP 500-trial statistical evaluation — real nginx ARM64 binary + trained encoder

evaluation_notes.test_design: Synthetic classes: legit windows use IPs sampled from nginx bloom filter (delta=0, static_violation=0 always); injected windows use IPs from heap 0x7f0000000000 range (not in bloom filter, static_violation=1.0 always). This creates perfect class separation by construction.
evaluation_notes.zero_variance_legit: All legit scores = 0.1154 because sc_type=NET_CON, resource=fixed, delta=0 are identical for all 500 windows — same feature vector, same AI divergence, same score every time.
evaluation_notes.static_layer_drives_result: With threshold=0.40, any window with static_violation=1.0 scores 0.40 + 0.6*ai_div >= 0.40 regardless of ai_div. Any window with static_violation=0 scores 0 + 0.6*ai_div ≈ 0.115 < 0.40. The static layer alone achieves 100% separation on pure classes.
evaluation_notes.real_world_caveat: Real-world mixed windows (some legit + some injected events, ip=0 for events without eBPF capture) will show intermediate scores. PCABP degrades gracefully to static-only mode when ip=0.
